hero.title: Astra 3D Engine
hero.subtitle: A joking 3D engine
hero.description: Create simple 3D games with simple operations.

viewport.title: 3D Viewport
viewport.description: Intuitive 3D viewport with perspective and orthographic modes, multi-viewport layout, and orientation cube for easy navigation.

hierarchy.title: Scene Hierarchy
hierarchy.description: Tree-structured scene hierarchy with drag-and-drop reordering, multi-selection, and context menu support.

inspector.title: Inspector Panel
inspector.description: Dynamic property inspector with transform controls, color pickers, and component-based editing.

assets.title: Asset Management
assets.description: Import and manage 3D models, textures, and prefabs with built-in file browser and preview support.

export.title: Export & Build
export.description: Export your games as standalone web applications or build desktop versions with Electron.

i18n.title: i18n Support
i18n.description: Multi-language support with English, Chinese, Japanese, and Russian translations built-in.
